thread:
acme-platform (Customer): hey team — we started seeing a ton of 429s around 14:05 UTC. looks like requests started getting throttled even though we're on the free tier and traffic is usually < 200 rps. any quick workaround?
Jordan (Support): sorry to hear that — can you paste the API request id or a curl that reproduces it? 429 responses usually include Retry-After header.
acme-platform (Customer): here's a curl we used in prod (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-neo-8k","input":"status check","max_tokens":64}'
```
acme-platform (Customer): response headers: `x-rw-request-id: rw_01abc`, `x-rw-rate-limit-remaining: 0`, `Retry-After: 30`, body: `{\"error\":\"rate_limit_exceeded\",\"message\":\"per-minute burst limit reached\"}`
Priya (Support): thanks — that confirms quota exhaustion. free tier has short burst windows and per-minute caps; if you saw a traffic spike the prefix cache/batching might not help. can you share org id or account email? we'll avoid posting it here.
acme-platform (Customer): sent org id to DM. this is blocking a customer demo in 2 hours :/ any temporary lift possible?
Jordan (Support): pinging ops: @ops-oncall can we consider a one-time temporary burst raise for rw_01abc org? needs to be limited and timeboxed (2h).
ops-oncall (Bot): Received. Filing exception request: EXC-4062. Ops will review 15-min SLA.
Carlos (Sales): looping in sales for quota upsell — @acme-platform we can fast-track a trial paid tier for 30 days if you want predictable throughput. need expected qps and avg tokens/request to size.
acme-platform (Customer): thanks @Carlos — we're averaging ~250 rps during the spike, typical request ~800 tokens input+output.
Priya (Support): ok that's helpful. rough math: 250 rps * 800 tokens ~ 200k tokens/s which is above free burst. Recommend temporary workaround: exponential backoff + client-side queueing + reduce max_tokens to 256 for the demo. also we can enable a short paid trial.
Jordan (Support): for repro steps, please run the curl above in a tight loop for ~60s and include `-D headers.txt -o body.json` to capture headers. paste the x-rw-request-id and Retry-After if you hit 429s.
acme-platform (Customer): did a local repro, attached headers: `x-rw-request-id: rw_01def, Retry-After: 25` and `x-rw-rate-limit-reset: 1769456954`.
Priya (Support): perfect — that confirms the per-minute bucket. ops, can we apply EXC-4062: grant +300 rps burst for org rw_01abc for 2 hours? will monitor.
ops-oncall (Bot): EXC-4062 approved by ops at 1769456845, applying temporary quota.
ops-oncall (Bot): Quota updated. New per-minute burst applied. Monitor metrics: https://console.redwood/metrics/org/rw_01abc
acme-platform (Customer): confirmed demo is back online. huge help, thank you! :tada:
Carlos (Sales): I'll DM terms for a 30-day paid trial and a one-time onboarding credit. if you want predictable capacity long-term, we can provision Dedicated or a higher Hosted tier.
Jordan (Support): follow-ups: (1) we recommend client-side retry with jitter (2) reduce max_tokens during spikes (3) accept temporary paid trial for stability. I'll keep thread open until you confirm no more 429s.
acme-platform (Customer): all good for now. final question: we saw an auth error earlier for one token rotation attempt — is that related?
Priya (Support): auth failures are separate; usually a 401 with `token_revoked` or `invalid_token`. if you rotated keys right before the spike some requests might have failed and retried generating additional load. check server logs for 401s.
acme-platform (Customer): will check logs and follow up if needed. thanks again. :pray:
Jordan (Support): marked resolved for now — reopen if anything else shows up. :thumbsup:
